agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and clean sensors; cart starts at x=0.437 with positive velocity 0.307 m/s. State-feedback controller gains adapted to plant (heavy pole 0.289kg, long pole 0.905m) provide insufficient position regulation: controller force stays ~0.85-0.87 N far below 65.7 N limit, while velocity remains ~1.34-1.37 m/s. Pole remains near upright (theta ~0.08 rad, margin ~0.71 rad) so pole_upright not triggering correction. Cart monotonically drifts outward until x=2.404 at step 261 exceeds |x|<=2.4. Counterfactual zeroing initial velocity prevents energy buildup and track exit, proving initial kinetic condition plus weak position feedback causes violation.
